summary: Pin is in dense, steep garden bush above a gully; no vehicle access.
reasons: Only footpaths nearby, no vehicle tracks
No pull-off or car park within 100 m

drivers.seclusion: Deep in bush, no dwellings, but no way for a van to reach it.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow garden footpaths only; the nearest road is 91 m south with no visible pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet; band shell lawn 64 m east, paths only.
drivers.convention: No sign of parking or overnight use.

flags: Steep: about 16% mean grade, 63% max at pin
Waterway 3 m from the pin, low ground about 33 m
Band shell and lawn are public daytime space
sun_shade: Full tree canopy over the pin.
